title: Deutsche Filmmuseum
notes: PDF page 31 (code 24). Extracted 2026-07-07 using poppler's pdftotext -bbox for text (word segmentation and German spelling verified reliable — pdf.js's own text layer was found to split/misspell words on this PDF's font, e.g. "Bundesfamilienministerium" was corrupted to "Bundesfamilienministirium"/"D eutsch lands") combined with pixel-sampled color classification (renders each page at 300dpi and samples actual ink RGB at each word's exact position) rather than the PDF's internal fill-color operator sequence, which was found to desync on pages with a corrupted/remapped font and silently misattribute colors between statements — the root cause of widespread wrong answers in earlier import passes. GREEN ink = Richtig, everything else = Falsch, per user's explicit manual-answer-key convention. Pale highlight washes and red Arabic annotation text are excluded from color classification and from the statement text entirely (personal notes, not exam content). Verified letter-by-letter against source images on 6+ pages spanning the full range (2, 7, 16, 22, 29, 30, 38, 40, 42) with zero spelling or answer discrepancies remaining.

statements.text: Die Quote der Hochschulabsolventen in Deutschland ist auf den internationalen Durchschnittswert von 32% angestiegen.
Berufspendler kritisieren unnötige Wartezeiten und Kosten der täglichen Fahrten.
Der Deutsche Bauernverband ist mit den diesjährigen Ernteerträgen im Allgemeinen zufrieden.
Das Deutsche Filmmuseum möchte die Besucherzahlen in Zukunft erhöhen.
Die Laufroute des Mainzer Gutenberg-Marathons führt traditionell nach Wiesbaden.
